query: How does the kernel handle a copy-on-write page fault when a process writes to a shared read-only page?

matches.reason: Main dispatcher invoked on a write fault to a present, write-protected PTE; decides whether the anon page can be reused in place or must be copied (COW), and calls wp_page_copy for the shared/private copy path.

Core copy-on-write implementation: allocates a new page, copies the old shared page's content, revalidates the PTE, and installs the new writable anonymous mapping while dropping the reference to the old shared page.
